title: Tool isolation, least privilege and human confirmation

videos.script: Tarefa's support assistant can now do things. It can look up an order, send a message and issue a refund. {{title}} The model does none of them itself. It writes a request for a tool call, and the code decides whether that request runs. {{proposal}} That decision is the subject of this lesson. The lab's gate reads each proposed call against a list of what this agent may touch. {{manifest}} A lookup for another client's order is refused, because the session belongs to one client and the model does not get to change that. {{scope}} A refund is held until a person confirms it, and the confirmation carries that person's name. {{confirm}} A refund larger than what was paid is refused outright, confirmed or not. {{limit}} And every conversation has a budget of calls, so that a loop stops on its own. {{budget}}
